title: Chef John's Hawaiian-Style Ahi Poke
description: Follow this easy Hawaiian-style poke recipe instead of frequenting those poke restaurants. You have to use the freshest tuna, even if that means frozen.
ingredients: 0.5 teaspoon kosher salt, or to taste
1 pound sushi-grade ahi (yellowfin) tuna, cut into 3/4-inch cubes
1 tablespoon thinly sliced green onions, or more to taste

steps.text: Make the poke: Whisk green onions, soy sauce, sesame oil, macadamia nuts, seaweed, ginger, pepper flakes, and salt together in a large glass or ceramic bowl. Add tuna and toss to evenly coat. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and marinate in the refrigerator for 2 hours.
Remove poke from refrigerator and stir. Sprinkle with green onions and sesame seeds, then drizzle lemon juice over top.

video.description: It's easy to make your own Hawaiian-style poke, but the catch is using the freshest tuna possible, even if that means frozen. Above and beyond that, all the other ingredients except for soy sauce are optional. In this video Chef John makes a marinade by whisking together soy sauce, sesame oil, fresh ginger, green onion, red pepper flakes, macadamia nuts and dried seaweed. Cut fish into cubes and mix thoroughly before refrigerating. Add acidic ingredients at the end then serve on top of sushi rice or cold noodles with seasonal vegetables for the perfect summer lunch.
